title: Analytics event workflow
responsibility: Resolves project and loop context, records local analytics events, fingerprints JSON-compatible values, and validates report references.

inputs.name: projectIdentity.root
inputs.description: Filesystem path used to resolve the primary Git worktree; if canonicalization or Git lookup fails, the resolved input path is returned.

inputs.name: resolvedContext.context
inputs.description: Requested analytics context for loop, step, task, agent model, and report selection. Task cannot be combined with loop or step, and step requires loop; missing values may come from HARNESS_ANALYTICS_* or HARNESS_AGENT_MODEL environment variables.

inputs.name: resolvedContext.root
inputs.description: Repository filesystem root used to locate loop state when a loop is selected.

inputs.name: recordAnalytics.event
inputs.description: Analytics event fields passed to AnalyticsRepository.record; this function adds the event ID, timestamp, and project identity. Recording is skipped when HARNESS_ANALYTICS_DISABLED is exactly 1, and repository failures are caught and logged.

inputs.name: recordAnalytics.root
inputs.description: Filesystem root used to identify the project for the event. Defaults to process.cwd(), the process working directory.

inputs.name: fingerprint.value
inputs.description: Value serialized with JSON.stringify before SHA-256 hashing. It must serialize to a string; cyclic values and values such as undefined that serialize to no string throw.

inputs.name: validateReport.context
inputs.description: Analytics context whose report, when present, must contain only letters, digits, or hyphens and identify a readable manifest under PROJECT_REPORTS_HOME or $HOME/.codex/project-reports.

outputs.name: projectIdentity
outputs.description: Canonical path from the first worktree entry in git worktree list --porcelain. If Git lookup fails or returns no worktree entry, the resolved input directory is returned.

outputs.name: resolvedContext
outputs.description: Context with loop, step, task, and report defaults from HARNESS_ANALYTICS_* variables and agentModel from the context or HARNESS_AGENT_MODEL. When a loop is selected, missing agentModel comes from loop state and loopRun is set to that state’s createdAt value.

outputs.name: recordAnalytics
outputs.description: Resolves after attempting to record the event, or immediately when analytics is disabled. Repository failures are caught and reported with a console warning.

outputs.name: fingerprint
outputs.description: 64-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of JSON.stringify(value).

outputs.name: validateReport
outputs.description: Resolves when no report is selected or when the report ID is valid and its manifest can be read.

errors.name: Invalid analytics context
errors.description: resolvedContext throws Error('Use either --task or --loop/--step.') when task is combined with loop or step, Error('--step requires --loop.') when step lacks loop, and Error('Loop step does not exist.') when the selected step is absent from loaded loop state.

errors.name: Loop state access failure
errors.description: When a loop is selected, failures from resolving its state path or reading its state propagate from resolvedContext.

errors.name: Invalid report reference
errors.description: validateReport throws Error('Invalid report ID.') when the report contains characters outside letters, digits, and hyphens. A readFile rejection propagates when the manifest is missing or unreadable.

errors.name: JSON serialization failure
errors.description: fingerprint throws when JSON.stringify fails, such as for cyclic data, or returns no string, such as for undefined.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: resolvedContext throws Error for incompatible task, loop, and step selections or an absent loop step; validateReport throws Error for a report ID containing characters other than letters, digits, or hyphens. Their exact messages are documented on the corresponding operations.
